examples.snippet:
curl -X POST '{{gatewayUrl}}/consultas-externas-api/api/v1/empresa/funcionamento' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "sorting": { "razaoSocial": "DESC" },
    "order": "DESC",
    "page": 1,
    "filter": {

   "cnpj":"19086699000182",
   "nomeFantasia":"radial",
   "dataPublicacaoInicial":"01/01/2024 01:00:00",
   "dataPublicacaoFinal":"01/06/2026 23:59:00",

   "classe":"29,31",
   "tipoProduto":"2,28",
   "uf":"SP"
}
  }'
